CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: I could have gained by not killing them.

CONTENT: でも 戦ったことで スレッタを死なせずに済んだ
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Pero al luchar evité que murieras tú.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: But by fighting, I've kept you alive.

CONTENT: そして もう一つ⸺
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: And one other thing...

CONTENT: スレッタが エアリアルと一緒に 戦ってくれたら...
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: If you fight together with Aerial, Suletta...

CONTENT: 無理だよ だって...
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: I can't. It would mean...

CONTENT: そうね　今 起こってるのは決闘じゃない
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Lo sé. Esto no es un duelo.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: That's right. What's happening now is not a duel.

CONTENT: 怖いよね　傷つきたくないよね
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Da miedo. No quieres lastimar a nadie.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: It's scary, right? You don't want to get hurt, do you?

CONTENT: でも あなたとエアリアルなら...
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Pero el Aerial y tú juntos...
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: But... If you and Aerial work together,

CONTENT: お母さんも スレッタも ミオリネさんも⸺　みんな救われる
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: A Miorine, a ti, a mí... Pueden salvarnos a todos.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: then Mom... and Suletta... and Ms. Miorine... Everyone can be saved.

CONTENT: 救う...
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Saved?

CONTENT: 今 みんなを救えるのは⸺　あなたたちだけよ
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Only the two of you can save them now.

CONTENT: スレッタ あなたは進める子
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Suletta, tú eres de las que avanzan.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Suletta, I know you're ready to move forward.

CONTENT: でしょ?
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Right?

CONTENT: うん 進める
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Yeah... I can move forward.

CONTENT: 進んで... きた
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: I have moved forward.

CONTENT: 逃げたら 1つ
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: If you run, gain one.

CONTENT: 進めば2つ
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Move forward, gain two!

CONTENT: やっほー
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Hi there!

CONTENT: 来たよ スレッタ・マーキュリー
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: I've arrived... Suletta Mercury!

CONTENT: エアリアル いるんでしょ?　出てきてよ
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: The Aerial is here too, right? Come on out!

CONTENT: それとも かくれんぼしてるのかな
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Or are we playing hide and seek?

CONTENT: エアリアル 見ーつけた
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: The Aerial... Found you!

CONTENT: ガンビット?
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: GUND-Bits?

CONTENT: お母さんから 教わらなかったんですか?
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Didn't your mother ever teach you?

CONTENT: そんなことしちゃ... ダメです!
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: You can't... behave like that!

CONTENT: やっぱり 君 エアリアル!
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: I knew it. You're the Aerial!

CONTENT: なんか怖い顔
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: That's a scary face you've got.

CONTENT: 前のほうが... 好きだったな!
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: If you ask me... I liked you better before!

CONTENT: この子もガンダム!?
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Is she a Gundam too?

CONTENT: あー またガンビット ズルいー
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: ¡Otra vez los GUND-Bit! No es justo.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Hey, GUND-Bits again? No fair!

CONTENT: 地球寮 船 無事?　ああ よかった あ...
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: ¿Los de la residencia? ¿Una nave? ¿Están bien? Menos mal.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Earth House... our ship... they're okay? Thank goodness.

CONTENT: ノレア 邪魔しないで!
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Norea, don't interfere!

CONTENT: あんたが いつまでも 遊んでるからでしょ
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: I have to unless you stop fooling around!

CONTENT: いくよ みんな!
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Now's our chance. Everyone!

CONTENT: オルコット 後退して!
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Olcott! Back off!

CONTENT: 実戦仕様じゃない? それで あの威力か...
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: ¿No es para luchar? ¿Y tiene esa potencia?
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: It's not meant for combat... but it's still that powerful?

CONTENT: スッゴーい
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Incredible!

CONTENT: ハート 撃ち抜かれちゃった
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: You've pierced right through my heart!

CONTENT: やれやれ
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Oh my.

CONTENT: 悪い予感だけは 当たるよな 俺
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: ¿Por qué mis malos presentimientos siempre aciertan?
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Only my bad feelings hit the mark.

CONTENT: タイムリミットだな
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: We've reached our time limit.

CONTENT: 全員 帰艦しろ 撤退する
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Regresen a la nave. Nos retiramos.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Everyone back to the ship. We're leaving.

CONTENT: えー! まだ 暴れたいのに!
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Huh?! I'm not done having fun!

CONTENT: 本気の魔女狩り部隊と ドンパチやる気?
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Do you want to mess with the gung-ho Witch Hunters?

CONTENT: ノレアは命が惜しいんだ?
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Conque tú valoras mucho tu vida.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Is your life that precious, Norea?

CONTENT: そんなこと言ってない
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: That's not what I said.

CONTENT: まあ いっか
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Whatever.

CONTENT: また会いにくるね　スレッタおねえちゃん
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Iré a verte otro día, hermanita Suletta.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: I'll come visit you again... Big Sister Suletta.

CONTENT: フォルドの夜明けから メッセージが来た
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Tenemos un mensaje de Alba de Fold.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: We've received a message from the Dawn of Fold.

CONTENT: 作戦は失敗したと
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: The operation failed.

CONTENT: アーシアンのガンダムねえ　関わりたくないな
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Un Gundam Earthian, ¿eh? No quiero relacionarme con eso.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Earthian Gundams, huh? We'd better not get involved.

CONTENT: 終わった?
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: It's over....?

CONTENT: うん そうだよね
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Right. It must be.

CONTENT: 見つけた
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Found her!

CONTENT: 今行くよ ミオリネさん!
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: I'm on my way... Ms. Miorine!

CONTENT: 絶対 助けてやる
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: I'll save you, no matter what.

CONTENT: 病院のベッドで一晩中 罵倒してやるんだから
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Te insultaré toda la noche en la cama del hospital.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: So I can curse you all night while you're in a hospital bed!

CONTENT: 見つけた デリング・レンブラン
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Found you, Delling Rembran.

CONTENT: 地球に帰れなくても⸺　お前とは ここで刺し違える!
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_SPANISH: Aunque no regrese a la Tierra, podré llevarte conmigo a la tumba.
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Even if I can't get back to Earth, I'm taking you down with me!

CONTENT: ミオリネさん!　クソ! うう...
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Ms. Miorine! Damn it!

CONTENT: やめなさい!
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Oh no you don't!

CONTENT: エヘヘ 締まらないなー
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: I'm such a klutz.

CONTENT: 助けに来たよ ミオリネさん
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: I came to rescue you, Ms. Miorine!

CONTENT: なんで...　笑ってるの?
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: How... How can you smile like that?

CONTENT: 人殺し...
CONTENT_TRANSLATION_ENGLISH: Murderer!
